prompt:

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a military camp tent or ready room in her element's kingdom

Outfit: a thin-strap camisole with wrap shorts tied at the hip — in deep sapphire blue; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEGS: crouched on the balls of her feet, knees bent.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — rutherfordium: the first synthetic element past the actinides, sitting below hafnium, claimed first in 1964 by a riverside research town and again in 1969 by a hillside laboratory, and named after a long dispute for the farm-born physicist whose students fired alpha particles at a sheet of gold foil thinner than a petal: almost all passed straight through, a few swerved, and about one in eight thousand bounced straight back, as astonishing as a shell fired at tissue paper returning to hit the gunner, revealing that every atom hides a tiny, heavy nucleus at its heart — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
